title: Withdrawing and editing a workout plan are barely tested on the server
what: The plan test withdraws a plan by changing the database row directly, never through the admin app's save, and never puts a withdrawn plan back. It checks the maker's name only for a plan the desk made; a plan the owner makes, and a trainer editing the owner's plan, are never checked to keep the right name. A second save is never checked to replace the routine without leaving a copy.
expected: Server tests that withdraw and restore a plan through the save, check the owner's name on an owner's plan, a trainer editing it, and that an edit replaces the routine in one record.
fix_line: Add server checks for withdraw and restore through the save, owner maker name and a trainer edit

title: Two family members on one mobile are never tested on the member's workout plans
what: No test gives two gym members the same mobile and asks for workout plans, so one member seeing the other's plan would pass. The plan-by-gym-plan rule is only tried with a plan that ended a month ago, never one that ended yesterday, starts tomorrow or renews today.
expected: Server tests for a shared mobile (a message, no plans) and for the first and last day of a gym plan.
fix_line: Add a shared-mobile case and edge-day cases to the plan test

title: Several workout offer refusals are never tested
what: Never tested: the desk giving a reward when the member has no plan, two desks giving at once leaving two notes lines, joining a closed offer of the member's own gym, the 21st date refused, rejoining keeping the old window end, stopping an offer keeping members' days, and the window-day and over-30 workout limits.
expected: Server tests for each of these refusals and promises.
fix_line: Add the missing offer refusal cases to the offer test

title: Message limits for members and bad messages are never tested
what: No test sends a bad or too-long message, marks more than 100 messages seen at once, checks that a new member sees only the last 14 days, counts seen for a group, checks a timed message's shown date, or takes back a message already sent within 10 minutes and sends another offer.
expected: Server tests for each of these limits.
fix_line: Add the missing message limit cases to the message tests

title: Half the HQ home list and gym page numbers are never checked
what: The HQ test checks members, check-ins, this month's money, staff and devices, but never last month's money, last activity, the newest-first order, a gym's last 20 HQ actions, the database size against 500 MB, the log's 100-row pages, or an HQ person who is gone.
expected: Server checks for each number HQ shows and for a removed HQ person.
fix_line: Check the remaining HQ list and gym page fields in the HQ test

title: The pause, new gym and sign-out records in HQ's log are never checked
what: The test checks the log row for approve and restore, but never the suspend row with its reason and from/to, nor the create_gym and sign_out_gym rows. Setting a gym back to trial is never tried, and the status after a refused pause is not read back.
expected: Server checks that each HQ action writes its log row with reason and time, and that moving a gym back to trial is refused.
fix_line: Read back the log row after each HQ action in the HQ test

title: A member leaving a paused gym, and the desk's other saves while paused, are never tested
what: The pause test lets a member leave an offer, but never has a member leave the gym itself while it is paused, so a refusal there (keeping the member's number) would pass. The desk's reward give and receipt while paused, the desk's check-in after restore, and the member's inbox and offers reads while paused are never tried.
expected: Server tests that a member can leave a paused gym with the number and dates removed, and that each desk save is refused while paused and works after.
who: members and front desk of paused gyms
fix_line: Add leave-the-gym, desk reward and desk receipt cases to the pause test

title: A new gym's owner code and signing a gym out are tested only half way
what: The test never checks that the new owner's code stops after one use or after 30 minutes, never shows the join code, never sets up an old owner key to check it is counted and kept, never tries an empty phone, and never signs a gym out twice.
expected: Server tests for one-use and expiry of the code, the old owner key, an empty phone and a second sign-out.
who: MettleUp HQ and new gym owners
fix_line: Add code reuse, expiry, old owner key and second sign-out cases

title: Cancelling a delete request is never tested
what: No test cancels a delete request, with or without a reason, or tries to reopen a cancelled one. The day-30 due date and the step times are never checked, and after a member erase request nobody checks the gym is still there.
expected: Server tests for cancel with a reason, cancel without one refused, reopen refused, and the due date.
fix_line: Add cancel, reopen and due date cases to the delete request test

title: Support access limits and its closing log row are never checked
what: The support test reads one member record, so the 200-record cap and newest-first order are never tried; the row count on each look, the support_close log row, and the person and address shown inside a window are never checked. The owner's sheet is checked for one sentence, not the list of what support can read.
expected: Server checks for the cap, order, row counts, the closing log row and the detail inside a window; the sheet's full list on screen.
fix_line: Add cap, order, row count and closing log checks to the support test
